visuals.author_rightsholder: Stuart A Hill AMS / UK Ministry of Defence, Crown copyright 2017
visuals.attribution_requirement: Attribute the image to Stuart A Hill AMS / UK Ministry of Defence, retain Crown copyright and source provenance, and link the Open Government Licence v1.0.
visuals.identity_evidence: The Wikimedia Commons file description explicitly identifies a UK M3 Amphibious Rig operated by a Corps of Royal Engineers crew during a joint UK/German bridging operation in Minden. The ENGINEER OSINT card ENG-TECH-0005 is the UK-German Wide Wet Gap Crossing programme. OCCAR's 30 October 2025 contract announcement identifies the programme's new M3 EVO capability, while Bundeswehr reporting identifies the existing UK-German M3 capability as Wide Wet Gap Crossing. This 2017 image therefore establishes the exact legacy M3 family and binational operational context only; it is not claimed to depict the new M3 EVO / Schwimmschnellbrücke 2 configuration.
